function.arguments: {"index": 2, "status": "dismissed", "resolution": "The finding was pre-registered by automatic checks. The estimand is the Pearson correlation between two continuous variables (flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g) across all penguins. Confounding between `species` and `island` does not bias the Pearson correlation coefficient itself, as it is a measure of linear association within the full dataset. The issue of confounding would matter only if we were comparing group means (e.g., mean body mass by species), which we are not. Therefore, this finding does not change the method for computing the correlation, and we can proceed with the overall correlation."}
